title: CRIC v0.1 Implementation Specification
summary: Defines v0.1 delivery contract: required repositories, twelve workstreams, milestones A-G with exit criteria, non-goals, and definition of done for GLOF reference implementation.
notes: No frontmatter, no markdown links. Competing signals: PRD-style goals/non-goals, milestone exit criteria and a 'Definition of Done' section versus SPEC-style enumeration of technical deliverables the build must honour (Pydantic/JSON schemas, ontology registry, OKF parser, graph materialiser, named API endpoints, five named agents). Resolved to SPEC via the ambiguity rule (SPEC > PRD) plus the document's own title 'Implementation Specification'. Confidence medium, not high: filename does not match the SPEC-*.md convention and the path segment is 'implementation' under a 'CRIC-PRD-v0.1' directory, so the path heuristic points weakly at PRD. Repository names (cric-core, cric-knowledge, etc.) are listed but are repos, not doc references, so cross_refs is empty.
